setlist.title: Going Down the Road Feeling Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mr. Charlie** (1 other source): Uploader's notes cover a segment running from Mr. Charlie into Going Down the Road Feeling Bad [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **Comes a Time**: back after 67 archived shows (653 days) [13]
- **Playing in the Band reprise**: rare: 12 archived performances [13]
- **The Other One v2**: rare: 4 archived performances [13]

## The recordings

- **deadco2023-06-25.FenwayParkBostonMA** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 186 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **deadco2023-06-25.EJL95**: source not stated; 22 songs; 185 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **deadco2023-06-25.neumann_km150.sunboy.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 189 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Recording captures the harmonies and Mayer's guitar clearly, contradicting the listener's muffled impression of the sound from behind home plate [11]
- **deadco2023-06-25.mbhombc410.flac24**: source not stated; 21 songs; 189 min [5]

## Around the show

- Listener sat behind home plate under a roof and found the in-venue Fenway sound muted and muffled [11]
- Listener, alone at Fenway after attending a memorial service the previous day, recalled leaving their seat during Drums at an early-80s Dead show [12]
- Taped from the front-of-board pit, left side, with mics raised eight feet [1]
- Uploader promoted a charity shirt sale benefiting the National Brain Tumor Society, run by brain cancer survivor Jon "Bubbles" Heller [2]
- Taped from behind section C5, beside the mixer enclosure just behind the infield; lineup included Jeff Chimenti and Jay Lane [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2023-06-25.FenwayParkBostonMA**: taped by JT/NY; transferred by JT/NY; source: Aud > Schoeps CCM 41V's > Lemo Cables > MixPre 6 II @ 32/48 [1]. Also: Schoeps CCM 41V and CCM 41 mics through Lemo cables into a MixPre 6 II at 32/48, edited in Sound Forge Pro 16 [1]
- **deadco2023-06-25.EJL95**: taped by Eric Lugassy; transferred by Eric Lugassy; source: Channels 1 & 2: AKG c414 XLII Hypercardioids PAS 20" apart > Channels 3 & 4: Audio Technica 3031 Cardioids PAS 32" apart > Channels 5 & 6: Vanguard V1… [2]. Also: Three mic pairs (AKG c414, Audio Technica 3031, Vanguard V1 omnis) recorded to SD, then processed in Reaper and delivered as 24-bit FLAC [2]
- **deadco2023-06-25.neumann_km150.sunboy.flac16**: taped by Steven Weld; transferred by Steven Weld; source: Neumann KM 150(AK50's/LC3's/KM100's)>HQRP xlr>Lunatec V3(w/ Oade neutral ACM Mod)>AES/EBU>Sound Devices SD722 @24bit/96kHz [3]
- **deadco2023-06-25.mbhombc410.flac24**: taped by Bob Crupi; transferred by Bob Crupi; source: MBHO/Haun MBC410 (dina)->Zoom F8Pro (48/24) [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [2023 OFFICIAL Dead and Company poster Fenway Park Boston 6/24-25/23 1224/5000 | #4647634483](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/2023-official-dead-company-poster-4647634483) [14]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [2023 OFFICIAL Dead and Company poster Fenway Park Boston 6/24-25/23 1224/5000 | #4647634483](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/2023-official-dead-company-poster-4647634483) [15]
